source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 7 exercise (PDF 191-193, key PDF 226).

blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 8 short (mukhtasar) aur 5 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein hai; wahan Roman Urdu lesson mein self-check ke taur par jawab diya gaya hai.

items: In mein se kaunsi cheez aam taur par Terms of Use ki common clauses (aam shartein) mein shamil NAHI hoti? (a) User obligations (b) Privacy and data use (c) Product advertising (d) Termination of service

Terms of Use mein “Limitations of Liability” clause aam taur par kya karti hai? (a) Company har masle ki poori zimmedari leti hai (b) Kuch ghalat ho jaye to company ki zimmedari limited (mehdood) karti hai (c) Har nuqsan par user ko rights deti hai (d) Har waqt service chalne ki guarantee deti hai
In mein se kaunsa harmful (nuqsan pohanchane wala) software chupke se aap ke computer ya phone ki activities ko monitor karta hai? (a) Spam (b) Cookies (c) Spyware (d) Pharming
Kaunsa khatra user ko us ke ilm ke baghair jaali websites par bhej deta hai? (a) Phishing (b) Spam (c) Spyware (d) Pharming

Digital divide taleem par kaise asar dalta hai? (a) Sab students ki parhai behtar karta hai (b) Taleem par koi asar nahi (c) Digital learning resources ke access mein na-barabari paida karta hai (d) Parhane ke purane (traditional) tareeqon ko bekaar kar deta hai
Data provenance ka kya matlab hai? (a) Maloomat tak pohanchne ki qeemat (b) Data ki history aur origin (c) Source ki popularity (mashhoori) (d) Maloomat ka kai zabanon mein tarjuma

Maloomat parakhte waqt bias samajhna kyun zaroori hai? (a) Opposing viewpoints (mukhalif raaye) ko nazar andaz karne ke liye (b) Source ke viewpoint ya agenda ko pehchan kar us ka hisab rakhne ke liye (c) Sab sources ko barabar reliable (bharose ke qabil) manne ke liye (d) Maloomat ko parakhne se bilkul bachne ke liye

In mein se society (muashre) par computing systems ka positive (achha) asar kaunsa hai? (a) Ghalat maloomat ka zyada phailna (b) Maloomat tak behtar access (c) Privacy ki fikr (d) Technology ka na-barabar access

Maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kya shamil hai? (a) Ijazat ke baghair content copy karna (b) Copyright ki respect (izzat) aur plagiarism se bachna (c) Maloomat share karte waqt data sources nazar andaz karna (d) Reports mein unverified (jis ki sachai check nahi hui) maloomat istemal karna

In mein se kaunsa kaam responsible digital behavior (zimmedari wala rawayya) NAHI? (a) Personal data sirf secure websites par dena (b) Social media par jhooti maloomat phailana (c) Online doosron ki privacy ki izzat (d) Suspicious (shak wali) online activities ki report karna
Users ke liye Terms of Use samajhna kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: 7.1.1)
Phishing aur pharming mein farq bataiye. (jawab: Pharming)
Cookies privacy ke liye faidemand bhi aur dakhal dene wali bhi kaise hain? Har ek ki misal dein. (jawab: 7.2.1.3)
Social aur civic participation par digital divide ke do asar bataiye. (jawab: kitab ka 7.1.2.3)
Information sources parakhne ke zaroori qadam (steps) kya hain? (jawab: 7.4.1)
Computing systems ne society (muashre) mein communication par kya asar dala? (jawab: 7.5.1)
Responsible data sharing maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kaise madad karti hai? (jawab: 7.6.2.1)
Online khatre pehchanne aur cybersecurity ke khatron se bachne ke do tareeqe bataiye. (jawab: 7.2.4.4)
Terms of Use ki common clauses samjhaiye aur bataiye ke yeh provider aur user dono ko kaise bachati hain. (jawab: 7.1.2)
Digital divide ko bridge karne ka concept (bunyadi khayal) samjhaiye aur is masle mein government initiatives ka role bataiye, Pakistan ki misalon ke saath. (jawab: 7.3.3)
Critical thinking skills maloomat ke zimmedari wale istemal mein kaise madad deti hain? Asal zindagi ki misalein dein. (jawab: 7.4.1.5)
Digital mahaul mein mil kar masle hal karne ki ahmiyat bataiye aur misalon se samjhaiye ke human-machine collaboration ise kaise behtar banata hai. (jawab: 7.6.4.1)
Accessible digital content ka concept samjhaiye aur disabled (maazoor) logon ki digital inclusivity (sab ko shamil karna) ke strategies (tareeqe) bataiye. (jawab: 7.6.5.1)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answer key (safha 223) Unit 7 ke sawal 1 se 6 ke ghalat jawab deti hai: 1 b, 2 a, 3 a, 4 c, 5 b, 6 c. Chapter ke text ke mutabiq sahi jawab hain: 1 (c), 2 (b), 3 (c), 4 (d), 5 (c), 6 (b). Maslan sawal 3 ka jawab Spyware hai, kyunke spam to unwanted messages hain, software nahi; aur sawal 4 ka jawab Pharming hai, kyunke text kehta hai ke pharming hi user ko jaali website par bhejti hai. Sawal 7 se 10 ke jawab (b) key mein sahi hain. Is ke ilawa kitab mein sawal 1 ka option (c) “©” chhapa hai; yeh option (c) hai.

items: MCQs ke sahi jawab: 1c 2b 3c 4d 5c 6b 7b 8b 9b 10b; kitab ki key sirf 7 se 10 mein sahi hai.
